scope: Additive benchmark execution metadata and comparison settings. Publication alerts were explicitly declined by the operator on 2026-11-23; no monitoring or notification work is included.

acceptance.expected: Execution freezes typed known model revision, deployment card count, context, quantization and harness build identity. Source distinctions are retained; positive counts only; strict controlled-run preflight rejects missing required metadata before inference. Legacy hashes/identifiers remain unchanged.

Store execution-time provenance per case; aggregate only consistent stored run evidence. Re-export under changed configuration cannot rewrite old evidence; mixed resumed runs are explicit and old fields remain unknown. Public fields are bounded and private metadata rejected.

Use authoritative nonempty cohort identity and recorded consistent complete quality settings, excluding unknown/incomplete/cohort conflicts. Model/quantization/hardware may vary as comparison subjects. Preserve existing ranks and exact speed joins; no controlled speed equivalence from labels/tags.

Show recorded per-side differences and unknown settings without guessing hidden cohort differences. URL-backed filter survives compare/return, reload and history, intersections and pagination; preserve excluded selections. Desktop/tablet/phone visual approval and CLI browser evidence are separate.

provenance_v1.strict_required: 40/64-hex immutable revision or 64-hex weights fingerprint; positive explicit deployment cards; positive known context; known quantization; actual versioned clean source-pinned executing harness. Mutable aliases and missing fields cannot satisfy strict preflight.

public_run_state.consistent: all included stored case provenance objects valid, present and identical; value is frozen object, possibly incomplete
public_run_state.missing: all included cases lack provenance or no eligible cases; value is null
public_run_state.mixed: mixed absence/presence or different objects; value is null

provenance_v1.legacy: optional absent fields; no export-time filling from current config; previous hashes/identifiers unchanged
